battle.wolf_win.speaker: Narration
battle.wolf_win.text: As the wolf falls, the purple flame scatters into ash. It looks… thinner than you imagined.

battle.wolf_win.speaker: Thought
battle.wolf_win.text: So this is the Black Flame. Even the beasts…

battle.wolf_win.speaker: System
battle.wolf_win.text: Learned [Wide Slash]. 25 gold, 2 stardust. Far off, stone walls stand in the morning light.

battle.wolf_lose.speaker: System
battle.wolf_lose.text: You wake by the roadside. Someone laid a cloak over you — they're already gone.

battle.leo_lose.speaker: Leo
battle.leo_lose.text: Go back to clutching grass roots.

battle.leo_lose.speaker: System
battle.leo_lose.text: You wake up back in the city. Return whenever you like.

battle.fog_lose.speaker: White Fog
battle.fog_lose.text: Lost, are we… want to try again?

battle.fog_lose.speaker: System
battle.fog_lose.text: Someone carried you back to Veilfog Village. Next time, wait for the real body to flare white.

battle.demon_lose.speaker: System
battle.demon_lose.text: You collapse on the tower steps. Just climb again from the bottom.

battle.abo_lose.speaker: Abo
battle.abo_lose.text: There's no way in your fist yet. Again.

battle.abo_lose.speaker: System
battle.abo_lose.text: You were politely shown out of the trial hall. The door isn't shut.

battle.falcon_lose.speaker: Swiftshadow
battle.falcon_lose.text: The wind carried you off… wait one more time.

battle.falcon_lose.speaker: System
battle.falcon_lose.text: You wake in the treehouse. Next time, strike when the wingbeats pause.

battle.boar_lose.speaker: Stonefist
battle.boar_lose.text: Not enough strength. Plant your feet and come back.

battle.boar_lose.speaker: System
battle.boar_lose.text: The waves push you back to the docks. Next time meet the charge head on — that's what cracks the rock plate.

battle.rift_lose.speaker: System
battle.rift_lose.text: The Black Flame flings you back to the foot of the tower. {tip}

battle.world_flee.speaker: System
battle.world_flee.text: You tear yourself free of the fight. You're badly hurt — find a save stone.
